coverage_explanation: Tests DISARM suppression of both alarm outputs across every physical PIR/door input combination, repeated DISARM operation, and STATUS reporting. The requirement does not specify sensor polarities, the light threshold, startup mode, alarm latching, event-counting/rearming rules, RESET semantics, or STATUS format. Consequently this suite does not prescribe an armed trigger combination, night-mode boundary, event count, or exact status text.
assumptions: The bench default active-HIGH LED wiring applies to D13.
D6 is a passive tone output, consistent with the authoritative tone_output role.
The light threshold is within the raw ADC range; A0=1023 is not below that threshold. All checks use this bright endpoint to avoid unspecified night-mode and DISARM precedence.
DISARM disables the alarm LED and buzzer regardless of the two sensor levels.
STATUS produces a nonempty serial response; its labels and formatting are unrestricted.
PIR and door-switch polarity and electrical pull configuration are missing. The disarmed tests enumerate all physical level combinations without assigning them logical meanings.

The reference chooses active-HIGH PIR, a door switch to GND with INPUT_PULLUP and HIGH meaning open, threshold 400, startup disarmed, edge-counted alarm episodes, and RESET clearing the count. These unspecified reference choices are not imposed by the checks.
